summary: The linux-gate evidence note now carries its input key, so a pull request that changes no linux-gate input can be matched to an earlier pass; the two whole-tree lints moved from the Rust test suite to genie-freshness

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Every enforce flag stays false: the key only adds shadow evidence until a later reviewed policy change turns skipping on.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Required check names are unchanged; genie-freshness runs two more lint scripts (about 6 s) and the Rust integration target loses the same two checks.

recovery.detail: Revert this change. Input-index refs already published stay valid: each still points at a signed record and is only an index.
